_port_note: The roll already happened in HRMoraleSystem; this card PRESENTS the outcome. Its one option carries the removal so the departure runs through CharacterRegistry.remove on resolve, which is what increments run_departures and emits the signal. Ekip §11.3: 'Ayrılma bir sistem tikinin sessiz sonucu değil, oyuncunun gördüğü bir olayın sonucudur.' tick:request, not a trigger on `employee_departed`: that signal is emitted by CharacterRegistry.remove, which this card's own option causes and which a firing calls too, so the card could only fire after the departure it announces, and after a firing it would announce the wrong thing. HRMoraleSystem names the card the moment the roll succeeds.
